canonical_model: PickupExecution / PICKUP_FOR; original registry and migrations unchanged
write_surface: Authenticated controller-only S05/S06 release; existing B19 source-bound HTTP/API/CLI request, fenced0005 Storage + durable native event; no generic event/ledger endpoint
scope: demo-city, WasteCollectionPoint WASTE-100, CollectionRoute ROUTE-C03, DEPT-SAN; target/route/source/review bound and validated
source: Explicit bounded synthetic one-occurrence scheduled-service/log observation; separate B09 reviewed deposit/field inspection. Runtime cannot read unreleased controller profiles
time: scheduled_at <= actual_at (COMPLETED) <= checked_at <= recorded_at. MISSED has explicit observed log result and no actual_at. UNKNOWN creates no PickupExecution. Deposit strictly later than actual_at, within real inspection lifecycle. Equal/reversed/unknown cannot establish sequence
authority: Authenticated department plus distinct authenticated analyst review; caller labels cannot confer VERIFIED; reviewed source and hashed canonical/journal/companion identities revalidated
qualifications: Candidate schedule != verified schedule; schedule != execution; no record != MISSED; completed != resolved; later waste != illegal dumping. Rule3 requires approved discriminating observation codes plus source/target/time scope; single log/report remains qualified, not independent cause verification
recovery: Original source-bound HTTP request remains RECOVERY_REQUIRED/UNKNOWN and blocks redispatch on committed-readback uncertainty. No replacement key/repair/rollback/clearance
monitoring: B14-2 outcome policy unchanged; evidence does not create plans/approvals/resolution
assessment_rule_scope: Rule3 applies to MISSED_PICKUP/ILLEGAL_DUMPING in controller-bound S05/S06 demo/current investigations; existing generic rule2 qualitative observations remain compatible and do not establish pickup-before-deposit service history
